title: In this town, your reflection does what you really want to do
description:
In this town, every reflection does what its owner really wants. My neighbour stands still at his window while his reflection does cartwheels. I don't have a reflection at all.

This spring my fiancée is getting our beach hut ready for summer, and every day her reflection in the hut window walks a little further away down the shore. Then one evening she's gone too, and the second deckchair outside our hut has turned to face me.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would your reflection be doing right now?
